title: Create Package Laioutr UI

parentEpic.title: Prepare Products within separated Packages, UI Kit, Laioutr UI and Laioutr UI Pro

summary: Create the Laioutr UI package containing e-commerce-focused components for building storefronts.
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Laioutr UI package provides the standard suite of e-commerce components needed for building online storefronts. It includes product displays, navigation elements, and shopping-focused components that build upon the foundational UI Kit.

## Use Cases

- Building standard e-commerce storefronts with ready-made components
- Implementing product listings, cards, and detail page elements
- Creating consistent shopping experiences across different stores

## Design Rationale

The Laioutr UI package represents the core offering for e-commerce implementations, providing a complete set of components for typical storefront needs. By building on the UI Kit foundation, it maintains consistency while adding commerce-specific functionality. The separation from Pro components ensures clear licensing boundaries and allows customers to choose the appropriate tier for their needs.
